meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Samoa (International Companies jurisdiction regulated by the Samoa International Finance Authority)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Common Law (with customary land law overlay)

Australia – Samoa Tax Information Exchange Agreement (TIEA)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act 2017 (ICA 2017), as administered by the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2018 (AML/CFT Act 2018); SIFA AML/CFT Guidelines and Compliance Rules; Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) operational framework under the Ministry of Police; Companies Act 2011 (for domestic entities only, not applicable to International Companies); Companies (Fees) Regulations and SIFA Fee Schedules.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized full-color copy of passport of each shareholder, beneficial owner, and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority of the country of residence/nationality
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if origin is an Apostille Contracting State; otherwise Consular Legalization through Samoa Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade (MFAT)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original bank reference letter (to include account opening date, conduct, and standing details)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed bank in the country of account domicile
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Bank official signature and seal; Apostille or Consular Legalization required where the registered agent mandates heightened verification

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or Certificate of Incumbency for any corporate shareholder or corporate UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign corporate registry or registered agent of the corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille; for non-Apostille registries, Consular Legalization via Samoa MFAT

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized proof of residential address (recent utility bill or bank statement, issued within the last 90 days)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization followed by Apostille (or Consular Legalization) where the document is externally generated

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, directors, and ultimate beneficial owners against the Samoa FIU published lists, OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List (1267/1988), EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK HMT Sanctions List, and SIFA AML/CFT Guidelines. Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs), including family members and close associates, require Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), verified source of wealth and source of funds, and senior management approval prior to incorporation. Sanctions and PEP screening must be repeated within 48 hours prior to certificate issuance.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) — International Companies Registry, online name reservation portal (https://www.sifa.ws)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory company name must appear in Latin-alphabet characters and end with a recognized suffix: 'Limited', 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Public Limited Company', 'Societe Anonyme', or recognized abbreviations (Ltd, Corp, Inc, PLC, SA). A Chinese-language name is permitted as a secondary registered name only, provided that an officially translated English transliteration is filed with and approved by the Registrar. All non-English characters in the primary name are disallowed; full-Chinese charter wording is acceptable as a supplementary constitutional instrument, but the operative English charter governs legal interpretation. Any name suggesting a connection with the Samoan Government or public bodies is prohibited.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant or licensed registered agent may file a written appeal with the Registrar of International Companies within 14 calendar days of the rejection notice, stating the grounds for reconsideration. The Registrar must issue a determination within 21 days of filing. A further appeal lies to the Supreme Court of Samoa by way of judicial review, to be commenced within 30 days of the adverse determination. Name reservation extensions may be applied for in writing before expiration, subject to payment of the then-applicable extension fee under the SIFA Fee Schedule.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible as the statutory registered office: the International Company must at all times maintain a physical registered office in Samoa at the premises of its SIFA-licensed registered agent, where statutory records and the UBO register are kept and made available to the Registrar and FIU. Central management and control may be conducted from outside Samoa for tax-exempt status, and a virtual administrative back-office (e.g., programmatic AdTech operations, sales platforms, and remote staffing) is fully permissible outside Samoa. The UBO register must be physically accessible in Samoa.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low risk for a non-licensed, non-captive, low-risk International Company engaged in media/advertising holding activities; quantified at less than 5% probability per annum of an unannounced SIFA or registered-agent-led physical inspection. The registered agent itself is subject to periodic SIFA examinations, and the company's records may be indirectly inspected through the agent.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Acts 1988-2012; ss.5 (incorporation), 7 (registration), 15-19 (share capital), 26-29 (directors), 33 (registered office); exemption from Business Licences Act 1998 for offshore activities
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Financial Services Authority (SIFSA), Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association (Charter) together with Form 1 (Statement of Particulars); Certificate of Incorporation issued thereafter
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital. Shares may be issued with or without par value in any currency and need not be paid up at incorporation (ss.15-16 IC Act 1987); no escrowed capital account is required for International Companies.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Certificate of Incorporation having been issued, the following be approved: 1. The subscribers in the Memorandum are confirmed as first shareholders and the allotment of one ordinary no-par-value share to each subscriber is ratified. 2. The registered office at the address filed with the Registrar is adopted as the Company's statutory registered office. 3. The registered agent is confirmed and retained. 4. The individuals named in the Statement of Particulars are appointed as first directors, with the Chief Executive authorized to manage day-to-day affairs. 5. The directors are authorised to open bank accounts, execute commercial agreements, and take all incidental actions for the Company's programmatic advertising technology platform.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, SIFSA (online portal and physical counter, Apia)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request for a proposed company name ending in 'Limited' or 'Ltd.' The Registrar checks the proposed name against the existing register and against prohibited or misleading names under s.7 of the IC Act 1987. A name clearance certificate is issued upon approval.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application form (prescribed form under IC Act)
Certificate of incorporation name availability request
Copy of applicant's identification or corporate resolution if an incorporator is a body corporate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused as undesirable or too similar, the incorporator may file an alternative name list for expedited reconsideration, or apply to the Minister for a discretionary review within 14 days of refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Charter and Statement of Particulars
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Incorporator (subscriber) and appointing registered agent; notarization in Samoa or recognized foreign notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare and execute the Memorandum and Articles of Association and the Form 1 Statement of Particulars identifying the first directors, the registered office, the registered agent, and the initial share structure. All signatures must be witnessed and consents to act appended.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association (2 original counterparts)
Form 1 - Statement of Particulars of International Company
Consent to act as director for each proposed director
Consent of registered agent
Certified copy of incorporator's passport or body corporate resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar queries defective execution or missing consents, the incorporator has 21 days to file corrected documents and resubmit; a fresh execution page may be added without re-notarization if permitted by the Registrar's practice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of Filing Fee and Statutory Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed Charter and Form 1 to the Registrar with the prescribed registration fee (USD 200 or equivalent WST). Upon satisfaction that the IC Act requirements are met, the Registrar registers the company and issues the Certificate of Incorporation with the registration number.
required_dossiers: Filed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Form 1 Statement of Particulars (stamped by Registrar)
Fee receipt or wire transfer confirmation
Name clearance certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is rejected, the Registrar must state the statutory ground; the incorporator may amend and resubmit within 21 days or apply to the Registry for a statement of reasons and subsequent judicial review under the IC Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Verification of Registered Office and Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa International Financial Services Authority (SIFSA), Registered Agents Section
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Confirm that the registered office is a physical address in Samoa maintained by a licensed registered agent, and that the agent holds a valid SIFSA licence. The registered agent files a copy of the Certificate of Incorporation and charter into its statutory client register.
required_dossiers: Consent of registered agent (Form 4)
Notice of registered office address in Samoa
Copy of Certificate of Incorporation
Licensed agent's client engagement letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent's licence lapses or the address is invalid, the Registrar will notify the company; the company must appoint a replacement licensed agent within 14 days by filing a notice of change of registered office/agent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting and Governance Installation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors (statutory organ of the company); minutes kept by the corporate secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the inaugural board meeting or adopt a unanimous written resolution approving the pro-forma First Board Resolution, allotting shares, confirming officers, adopting the registered office, and authorizing bank account opening and platform commercial contracting. Sign the minutes and file them in the statutory minute book.
required_dossiers: Notice of first board meeting
Pro-forma First Board Resolution (signed by all directors)
Register of directors and officers
Register of members (share ledger)
Bank account opening mandate (executed)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a director is unavailable, the board may act via written resolution signed by all directors within 7 days; absent director signatures may be cured by a later ratification resolution at the next board meeting.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Statutory Records and Annual Compliance Setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies / SIFSA and the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Maintain the statutory registers at the registered office, obtain the Certificate of Good Standing, and set up the annual renewal calendar for the IC licence fee. Confirm exemption from domestic business licensing by filing the IC statutory declaration of offshore activity if requested by MCIL.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Register of members and directors
Annual renewal fee schedule from SIFSA
Declaration of offshore operations (for business licence exemption)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If annual renewal is missed, pay the late filing penalty and submit a reinstatement application; the Registrar may restore the company to good standing after a declaration that it has not traded while struck off.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Samoa International Financial Services Authority (SIFSA) in conjunction with the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) - Business Licensing Division; industrial operating licence exempt for International Companies performing offshore programmatic advertising services only
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Exempt - International Company status under IC Act 1987; no domestic operating licence required under the Business Licences Act 1998 provided the company does not carry on business in Samoa

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA), Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), Samoa
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt / Permitted Activity - purely office-based AdTech platform with no manufacturing, mining, or land-disturbing operations; no full EIA Report required under the Planning and Urban Management Act 2004
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero point-source industrial discharge; any sanitary wastewater from the registered office must comply with the Waters Act 1965 and applicable National Effluent Standards administered by MNRE; electronic waste (servers, terminals, batteries) must be disposed of through licensed e-waste contractors; electromagnetic and noise emissions from telecommunication equipment must comply with OSH exposure thresholds.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (SFESA) under the Fire and Emergency Services Act 2007 covering fire extinguishers, emergency exits, and evacuation plans; structural load and electrical wiring inspection compliance certificate for the registered office premises; workplace clearance under the Occupational Safety and Health Act 2002 administered by MCIL - OSH Division, including workstation ergonomics and electrical safety audits.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Samoa Revenue Authority (SRA), succeeding the Ministry of Revenue for all tax administration, with the Samoa Taxpayer Online Services portal (https://www.sra.gov.ws); customs matters are handled by the Samoa Customs Service under the Ministry of Revenue.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: An International Company (IC) incorporated under the International Companies Act 2017 is registered with the Registrar of International Companies at the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) and does not apply for a domestic TIN; the SIFA certificate of incorporation serves as the statutory tax identity. No VAGST registration is required or permitted for an IC because the entity is statutorily outside the scope of the Value Added Goods and Services Tax Act 2008. If a TIN is needed solely for foreign bank onboarding or CRS/FATCA documentation, the IC may request a non-resident TIN from the SRA, which does not trigger any Samoan tax liability.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None applicable. Samoa has no check-the-box or flow-through election regime; the International Companies Act 2017 confers an automatic, non-waivable zero-tax status on International Companies, which are deemed non-resident and exempt from all Samoan income tax, withholding tax, stamp duty, and VAGST. No hybrid mismatch or entity classification election is available under Samoan law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAGST (Value Added Goods and Services Tax) under the Value Added Goods and Services Tax Act 2008, as amended
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: SAT 60,000 in taxable supplies over any consecutive 12-month period; mandatory VAGST registration applies to resident suppliers exceeding the threshold, but Samoan International Companies remain outside the VAGST net irrespective of turnover
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time electronic fiscal clearance or digital stamping mandate exists in Samoa. VAGST-registered suppliers must issue standard tax invoices in paper or electronic format under the VAGST Act 2008, and e-filing is available through the SRA portal; however, no government API clearance or B2B continuous transaction control is imposed on International Companies.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: For VAGST-registered entities, zero-rating applies to the direct export of goods evidenced by customs clearance and to services supplied to non-resident recipients where the benefit is enjoyed outside Samoa and the recipient is not a resident of Samoa. A Samoan International Company is not VAGST-registered and therefore cannot claim input credits or zero-rated refunds; its offshore advertising intermediation services are simply outside the Samoan indirect tax base.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Samoa Customs Export Declaration filed through ASYCUDA World with customs clearance endorsement
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical removal of goods from Samoa
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT MT103 credit advice evidencing receipt of foreign consideration
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent or unsupported export zero-rating claims under the VAGST Act 2008 may result in clawback of all input credits, a late payment penalty of up to 25%, monthly default interest of 1%, additional penalties up to 200% of the tax evaded, fines up to SAT 100,000, and imprisonment up to seven years. For a Samoan International Company, any breach of the International Companies Act 2017, such as carrying on trade with Samoan residents without authorization, exposes the IC to loss of its tax-exempt status, retrospective assessment of all Samoan taxes, deregistration by SIFA, and director liability penalties.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS; Faletupe Tutotonu o Samoa), operating under the Central Bank of Samoa Act 1984 and administering exchange control under the Exchange Control Act 1976 and the Exchange Control Regulations 1977, with AML/CFT supervision under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2017 (as amended) and the KYC Rules 2018.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan Tala (WST) is a regulated but partially convertible currency pegged to a weighted basket comprising the USD, EUR, JPY, AUD and NZD. Current-account payments are permitted for residents upon submission of an exchange-control declaration, whereas capital-account transfers require prior CBS approval. A Samoa International Company (IC) is expressly exempted from exchange control under Section 247 of the International Companies Act 1987: all IC subscriptions, receipts, and distributions may be effected in freely convertible foreign currency without CBS approval, and dividends or capital distributions to non-resident shareholders are not subject to profit-remittance approval or withholding tax. The practical hurdles are bank-level rather than statutory: the bank will require KYC evidence of beneficial ownership, economic substance documentation, and an invoice-backed purpose code before releasing an outward USD wire. The IC treasury ledger should be maintained 100% in USD because holding WST balances domestically may trigger domestic-income classification and dilute the exchange-control exemption.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: General Samoa trading companies exporting goods must receive full payment within 90 days of shipment and surrender/convert 100% of the export proceeds into WST through a CBS-licensed dealer unless a written exemption is granted. This rule is disapplied to International Companies: a Samoa IC deriving programmatic advertising service revenue from offshore advertisers is not an exporter of goods, and under Section 247 of the International Companies Act 1987 it may retain USD advertising revenue in a USD-denominated Samoa bank account or offshore with no statutory repatriation, surrender, or conversion obligation. If the IC were to invoice a Samoa-resident advertiser and receive WST, the proceeds would fall into the domestic regime; therefore, the treasury policy must exclude domestic invoicing and keep all contracting parties non-resident.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: USD Corporate Operating Account and USD Capital Escrow Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (Samoa) Limited, Apia
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: USD Operational Account with SWIFT and correspondent USD clearing

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Samoa Commercial Bank Limited (formerly National Bank of Samoa), Apia
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: USD Operating Account and Capital Escrow Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW. Samoa has no electronic-money institution or digital-bank licensing regime, and a Samoa International Company cannot passport an overseas EMI licence into the jurisdiction. Global EMIs (Wise, Payoneer, Mercury, and similar multi-currency platforms) routinely decline entities incorporated in Pacific offshore centres, including Samoa, because their correspondent banks treat the jurisdiction as elevated-risk under FATF-style de-risking. The realistic use of an EMI for this structure is limited to a downstream disbursement rail for paying publishers and SSP counterparties without being the primary treasury concentration account; the core liquidity must sit in a CBS-licensed bank account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote onboarding is permitted on a case-by-case basis: a CBS-licensed bank may accept notarised corporate registers, certified passport copies, the Certificate of Incorporation, and a Board Resolution appointing signatories, accompanied by a live video interview of the directors and an electronic signature-card verification conducted by the bank's compliance officer. In practice, the first signatory is strongly encouraged to attend a single in-person branch appointment in Apia to establish the signature mandate; alternatively, the introduction of the licensed registered agent under the International Companies Act can substitute for physical presence. All non-resident directors must complete a CBS-AML individual questionnaire, a beneficial-ownership declaration, and a source-of-wealth statement regardless of whether opening is remote or physical.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Nominee or bearer-type ownership structure of the International Company obscuring the ultimate beneficial owner.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver the CBS-compliant Beneficial Ownership Register extract issued by the Samoa International Companies and Trusts Registry, the registered agent's CDD file, a lodged instrument of trust or nominee declaration showing the professional fiduciary, and a Board Resolution naming every ultimate natural-person owner with percentage holdings.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity, multi-counterparty AdTech settlement flows (hundreds of micro-payments from DSP/SSP counterparties) creating a transaction-pattern red flag for money mules.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Supply the signed programmatic marketplace agreements (SSP/DSP contracts), a 3-month projected settlement ledger showing payer and invoice mapping, the platform's payment reconciliation algorithm, the advertiser and publisher whitelist with jurisdiction breakdown, and the company's transaction-monitoring policy that flags and auto-suspends anomalous deposits.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt IC status without credible economic substance in Samoa being classified as a shell or brass-plate company.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide the annual Economic Substance Return or sworn declaration, evidence of the Samoa physical office lease or serviced-office agreement, the resident registered agent and local company secretary appointment, board minutes recording strategic decisions taken at meetings in Apia, and the payroll or contract records of the local manager.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Revenue originating from high-risk or sanctioned advertising jurisdictions triggering CBS red flags on source of funds.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit IP-geolocation and domain-level data proving that ad impressions are served to compliant geographies, the sanctions-screening output for all advertiser and payment IDs, the AdTech platform's ad-verification certificate (IAS or DoubleVerify equivalent), and a written enhanced-due-diligence policy with geo-blocking rules excluding sanctioned advertisers.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder equity is injected by SWIFT MT103 from the beneficial owner's corporate or personal bank, with field 50K naming the remitter, field 59 naming the Samoa IC and its USD account, and field 70 referencing the purpose code DIRECT-INVEST-CAPITAL together with the IC certificate number. The Samoa receiving bank will require a Board Resolution authorising the Capital Escrow Account, a notarised share subscription letter, the source-of-funds declaration (audited accounts or 12 months of bank statements of the shareholder), and the CBS exchange-control declaration form (Form EX-1) for balance-of-payments statistical reporting even though the IC itself is exchange-control exempt. Deposits are verified against the share register before being migrated from the escrow ledger to the Operating Account.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: The primary clearing rail for publisher and traffic-acquisition settlement is SWIFT MT103 executed in USD through the bank's correspondent network (typically BSP or ANZ clearing corridors in New York or Sydney), with field 70 containing the counterparty SSP/DSP invoice number for audit alignment. For larger committed media-inventory buys, a standby Commercial Letter of Credit under UCP600 may be issued by the Samoa bank through its correspondent to the publisher's presenting bank; documentary credits are atypical in real-time AdTech but usable for quarterly minimum-volume delivery guarantees. Same-day US domestic payouts to publisher bank accounts are executed via ACH Direct rails through the IC's USD account held with the Samoa bank's US clearing partner. All outbound wires are subject to the CBS balance-of-payments reporting threshold per transaction, and each disbursement must be supported by a matching invoice in the platform ledger to avoid AML review delays.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/WST spot contracts for converting incidental WST operating expenses and local registered-agent fees
USD/WST vanilla forward contracts up to 12 months, permitted only against documented invoice-backed SSP/DSP receivable exposures
Cross-currency swaps between USD and WST for intercompany working-capital loans, executed through a CBS-licensed commercial bank

Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing WST via the correspondent bank or a licensed offshore desk, permitted where the underlying is a confirmed ad-revenue receivable and the contract does not create speculative WST exposure in Samoa

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return and Annual Government Fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after the anniversary of incorporation date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalties accrue monthly; persistent non-filing may lead to administrative strike-off and loss of limited liability protection

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit required for ordinary International Companies unless the company is a bank, insurance, or other licensed financial institution under Samoa law
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) adopted voluntarily; no mandatory audit or filing of financial statements for non-licensed ICs

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annual Return must confirm current shareholders and directors; any share transfers must be recorded in the Register of Members and reflected in the annual return; UBO information is maintained with the registered agent but no separate public annual UBO filing exists

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,000 - 8,000 (only if license or commercial counterparty requires an audit)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for qualifying International Companies (ICs) on offshore income; 27% standard corporate rate for taxable resident companies under the Samoa Income Tax Act 2012
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: ICs are fully exempt from Samoan corporate income tax on all income derived outside Samoa. No capital gains tax. No tax on dividend distributions made by an IC. No stamp duty on transfers of IC shares. Domestic trading in Samoa removes the exemption.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: CIT1 – Corporate Income Tax Return (Samoa Ministry for Revenue, e-Filing Portal; paper forms accepted for exempt entities)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: 3 months after the end of the accounting period; provisional tax instalments due quarterly for taxable companies

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Samoa Taxpayer Identification Number / Company Registration Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the IC's 12-digit Samoa International Companies Registry number where no IRD number has been issued; obtain a TIN from the Ministry before filing any return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 – Global Income & Samoan Source Income
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement of worldwide income and separately identified Samoan-source income
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For an IC, declare 'Exempt under International Companies Act 1987 Section 12' and enter zero for all Samoan-source lines. Do not claim deductions in excess of Samoan-source gross income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Expenses incurred in producing assessable income; losses carried forward under time limits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only expenses directly connected with Samoan-source business are allowed. An IC should show no expense allocations for foreign operations.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Self-assessment of net tax due after credits and treaty relief
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If an IC has no Samoan taxable income, enter 0. Any claim of treaty withholding relief requires an attached Form DTA-1 and tax residence certificate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signature of director or authorised tax agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Sign as 'Director, International Company' and ensure the name appears on the registered list of directors.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of 10% of tax assessed; monthly surcharge of 2% for up to 12 months; on conviction, fine not exceeding WST 100,000 and imprisonment up to 2 years. For exempt ICs, failure to file an annual return with the Registrar results in late fees and potential strike-off.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: International Company Annual Return and Annual Fee Declaration (Samoa International Companies Registry, online e-Registry)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: On or before the anniversary of incorporation each year, or within one month after the anniversary if agent filing extensions are granted

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company name, registration number, date of incorporation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the exact name as shown on the Certificate of Incorporation. ICs are non-resident entities for tax purposes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section B – Registered Agent and Registered Office
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Address of licensed registered agent and service of process address in Apia
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must maintain a licensed Samoan agent under the International Companies Act; agent holds the register of directors and shareholders.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, address, and nationality of all directors and shareholders; details of ultimate beneficial owner
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose the natural persons behind the IC. The platform operator entity should list the beneficial owner to satisfy AML requirements.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: ISIC code and description of principal activities
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State 'ISIC 7310 – Advertising; programmatic ad exchange / SSP platform'. Confirm operations are conducted exclusively outside Samoa.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Government fee based on authorised share capital
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Pay via licensed agent using WST or USD. Late payment attracts penalty and possible restoration fee.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Penalty of WST 200 for late annual return; an additional WST 15 per company per year; failure to pay annual government fees for 3 consecutive years may result in dissolution and loss of limited liability.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 15% on dividends paid by a Samoan domestic resident company to a non-resident; 0% for distributions made by an International Company under the International Companies Act because the distribution is not Samoan-source
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: A non-resident shareholder must file a form DTA-1 with the Samoan Ministry for Revenue before the dividend is paid; provide a valid Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) and a written statement of beneficial ownership. The withholding agent must retain the TRC and acceptance letter. For an IC, no Samoan WHT arises and no treaty relief is needed because dividends flow from a non-resident exempt entity
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: statutory 15% for non-residents; treaty rates may reduce to 10% or 0% under an applicable DTA. Interest: statutory 15% for non-resident debt providers; treaty rates typically 10% or 0%; ICs face no Samoan WHT on interest paid to foreign lenders if the borrowing is not connected to a Samoan permanent establishment

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No explicit annual threshold is published for ICs. For taxable companies, Samoa applies the arm's length principle under the Income Tax Act 2012; the Ministry for Revenue may require a transfer pricing study where related-party transactions exceed WST 2,000,000 in aggregate or where the transaction is judged to lack economic substance
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2019 requires an IC that carries on a relevant activity (including 'holding business' and 'service business' – an AI/SSP platform acting as a service or intermediary) to maintain substantial economic presence in Samoa: physical office or premises, qualified employees, sufficient operating expenditure, and core income-generating activities conducted in or from Samoa. A pure equity holding IC only needs an adequate registered office, staff for holding and managing its shares, and compliance records. The Tax Administration has power to impose penalties for failure; the benefit of IC tax exemption may be denied if economic substance is absent.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / Misdeclaration of Samoan-Source Revenue
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: An IC accepts advertising services revenue from Samoa-based advertisers or generates revenue through a Samoan permanent establishment without filing a CIT1 return and instead claims blanket offshore exemption
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Exemption is void; 27% corporate income tax applied to undeclared Samoan-source income; penalty of 100% of the tax understated, late-payment interest of 2% per month, and criminal fine up to WST 100,000
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the tax agent are jointly and severally liable for unpaid penalties; travel bans may be issued by the District Court; imprisonment up to 2 years for intentional evasion

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The SSP and programmatic ad exchange is operated from offices in Singapore or London with no presence in Samoa; the IC is only used to channel royalty or digital service fees and conducts no board meetings in Samoa
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Denial of IC tax exemption; retrospective assessment on worldwide income at 27%; penalty of WST 50,000 for non-compliance with ESR; the Registrar may strike off the company
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are liable to pay a personal penalty equivalent to 150% of the revenue earned through the shell arrangement; disqualification as director; cancellation of Samoa residency status

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC fails to file the annual beneficial ownership return with the Financial Intelligence Unit or deliberately conceals the ultimate controller of the programmatic ad exchange
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Civil penalty up to WST 500,000; freezing orders over bank accounts; criminal fine up to WST 1,000,000 and imprisonment for 7 years under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Act
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors personally liable to criminal prosecution; assets may be confiscated; a failure to cooperate with the FIU triggers a travel ban and mandatory notification to Samoa's international law-enforcement partners

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The non-resident owner attempts to claim DTA reduction of Samoan dividend WHT without obtaining a valid Samoan tax residence certificate, or routes distributions through Samoa merely to obtain a paper IC benefit while not complying with substance rules
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Withholding tax shortfall must be paid immediately by the paying company; penalty of 120% of the WHT due; denial of all treaty benefits under the Limitation of Benefits article in Samoa's DTAs
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign the tax declaration face personal fines up to WST 250,000 and imprisonment of up to 3 years for making false statements to the Ministry for Revenue
